[[File:Grievous_dream.png|200px|thumb|Qymaen jai Sheelal, a khagan]]
'''Khagan''' was a title of [[Military rank/Legends|Supreme Military Commander]] of the [[Kolkpravis]], a title held first by [[Grievous/Legends|Qymaen jai Sheelal]]. Several [[Brigade (Kolkpravis)|brigades]] were organized as a [[khanate]], overseen by one of the eight [[Khan/Legends|Khans]] of the [[Izvoshra/Legends|Izvoshra]], who was responsible for safeguarding and carrying out their [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] military leader duties.<ref name="GAW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>
